name: Project Manager help
description: Help mode entries of the Project Manager plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Project Manager
entries.text: Every project is its own console with its own builds, notes and data. Create, rename, switch and remove projects here.

entries.title: New project
entries.text: Opens the form for a new project: a new app, or framework / self development.

entries.title: Create project
entries.text: Makes the project: its own console link, its own builds, notes and data folders, and for a new app a folder under apps/ with a project manifest.

entries.title: Multi-project view
entries.text: On: the whole console shows a tab group with each project's console running. Off: just this console.

entries.title: Layout
entries.text: Tabs show one project's console at a time; side by side shows every open project at once.

entries.title: Live preview
entries.text: Opens a window where the app being built renders live while you work in the console.

entries.title: Live preview window
entries.text: Turns the live preview window on or off.

entries.title: Preview window
entries.text: Floating (drag it anywhere) or docked on the right or at the bottom.

entries.title: Switch to
entries.text: Makes this the active project; in the multi-project view its tab comes to the front.

entries.title: Open its console
entries.text: Opens this project's own console instance in a new browser tab.

entries.title: Rename
entries.text: Change the project's name or the URL its live preview shows.

entries.title: Preview URL
entries.text: Where the app runs while you build it (http(s):// or a path on the console). The live preview shows it.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Takes the project off the list. Its app folder stays; its builds, notes and data folder stays unless removed through the API.

entries.title: Project Manager settings
entries.text: Multi-project view, layout and the live preview window, plus install and uninstall.

entries.title: Turn the multi-project view off
entries.text: Closes the project tabs and goes back to just this console. The projects stay.

entries.title: Dock it
entries.text: Docks the live preview on the right edge of the console (or at the bottom).

entries.title: Float it
entries.text: Turns the docked live preview back into a window you can drag and resize.

steps.say: Every project here is its own console, with its own builds, notes and data.
New project makes one: a new app, or work on the console itself.
Turn on the multi-project view to see every project's console in tabs, and open the live preview to watch the app as you build it.
